definition: This design milestone aims to layout major design elements of the project. This is the foundation on which the project design will sit.

After the 30% drawing set is reviewed, the incorporated revisions are published in the 60% design set. At the 60% design phase, the team should focus on reviewing for constructability and value engineering since making changes at this stage is less costly.

Revisions made during the 60% design review are incorporated in the 90% design. The 90% drawing set includes all the plans and specifications for the project. Once the review and revisions are made to the 90% set, then the drawings are issued for permitting with the local AHJ.
